Job Description:

The CIO Private Bank AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) is the core AI enablement function of Deutsche Bank's Private Bank. We enable the Private Bank business and CIOs to deliver their AI ambitions faster, more safely and at lower cost. We drive delivery across business areas, make reusability the standard and build central AI capabilities. 

We work in a forward-deployed model: AI  acceleration leads, engineers, architects and agent operators are embedded in the business and CIO streams and accelerate delivery from discovery to production. You will enable delivery across the different domains and accelerate the portfolio in progress. What we build in one domain becomes reusable components, agent patterns and shared platforms for the others.

Our focus is delivering the Private Bank AI strategy and enabling its transformation. With the business, central AI Hub and the TDI CIOs, we accelerate one AI portfolio, prioritised by value, risk and reuse. We redesign processes end to end, keeping the human decision at the core, and we make governance operational, building evaluation and control into the path to production. 


As an AI/ML Ops Engineer, you will design, build and operate the platforms, infrastructure and automated pipelines that take machine learning models, prompts and AI agents from experimentation to secure, reliable production use. You will combine DevOps, platform and site-reliability engineering with practical knowledge of machine learning, Generative AI, LLMOps and AgentOps.

Working with AI engineers, data scientists, software engineers, architects, SRE, security and control functions, you will make AI delivery repeatable, observable, governed and cost-efficient at scale. You will own solutions from architecture and infrastructure-as-code through CI/CD quality gates, deployment, monitoring, incident response and continuous improvement, with particular focus on GCP, Kubernetes, multi-tenant platforms and regulated-environment controls.


Responsibilities

  • Build and operate AI/ML platforms covering model and API gateways, model registries, feature and vector stores, experiment tracking, evaluation services and self-service capabilities for product teams.
  • Create CI/CD pipelines for models, prompts, agents and infrastructure, including versioning, environment promotion, approvals, automated tests, evaluation gates, rollback and reproducible releases across DEV, UAT and production.
  • Automate AI and agent evaluations using golden datasets, simulations and LLM-specific metrics such as faithfulness, hallucination rate, tool-selection accuracy, safety, latency, token usage and cost; detect regressions before release.
  • Integrate non-deterministic AI testing and LLM-as-judge methods with deterministic quality controls such as static analysis, unit and integration tests, coverage checks and policy enforcement.
  • Design modular, production-grade infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, including remote state, reusable modules, provider upgrades, policy controls and automated tenant onboarding and offboarding.
  • Build secure GCP landing zones and workloads using Cloud Run, GKE or Kubernetes, Serverless VPC Access, Private Service Connect, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Secret Manager, Cloud KMS, IAM and Workload Identity Federation.
  • Architect zero-trust delivery workflows that avoid static credentials, enforce environment protections and apply DevSecOps scanning for source code, dependencies, containers, artefacts and infrastructure.
  • Deploy and operate containerised ML and agent runtimes, MCP servers and, where required, self-hosted models using technologies such as Helm, External Secrets Operator, vLLM, TGI or Triton on CPU or GPU infrastructure.
  • Support training, fine-tuning and retraining workflows through data pipelines, reproducible environments, package and dependency management, experiment tracking and controlled model promotion.
  • Optimise inference and platform performance for latency, throughput, availability and cost using autoscaling, batching, quantisation, caching, model routing, token budgets and GPU capacity planning.
  • Implement production observability using metrics, logs, traces, dashboards and alerting for infrastructure, models and agents, including quality, drift, errors, latency, tool calls and cost; support root-cause analysis and incident response.
  • Enforce security and governance through least-privilege access, secrets and certificate management, OAuth2 or OpenID Connect, mTLS, data protection, audit logging, model inventory, lineage and model-risk evidence.
  • Integrate AI workloads with enterprise gateways and identity services, applying authentication, authorisation, rate limits, quotas and safe tool permissions; maintain kill switches, traffic controls and human approval for high-impact actions.
  • Design for high availability, resilience and disaster recovery, with capacity planning, service-level objectives, deployment and rollback strategies, operational runbooks and tested recovery procedures.
  • Provide reusable platform patterns, documentation and support so teams can ship AI capabilities safely with minimal manual intervention; review designs, troubleshoot complex cross-layer issues and mentor engineers.
  • Collaborate in Agile delivery and balance security, reliability, governance, developer experience, operational complexity and cost when making architectural decisions.

Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least 6 years of experience in software, cloud, platform, DevOps or site-reliability engineering, including at least 3 years operating ML or AI workloads in production; equivalent depth of relevant experience may be considered.
  • Strong hands-on experience with GCP and services such as Cloud Run, GKE, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud SQL, IAM, KMS, Secret Manager, VPC networking and private connectivity; AWS or Microsoft Azure experience is an advantage.
  • Advanced Kubernetes, GKE, Docker and Helm experience, including workload identity, networking, autoscaling, secrets, deployment strategies, troubleshooting and production operations.
  • Production-grade Terraform expertise covering modules, state, remote backends, lifecycle management and provider upgrades; Terraform Enterprise and Sentinel policy experience is an advantage.
  • Deep CI/CD and Git experience, preferably GitHub Actions with reusable workflows, composite actions, environment protections and Workload Identity Federation; familiarity with Jenkins or equivalent platforms is beneficial.
  • Practical DevSecOps experience with tools such as Prisma Cloud, Veracode and JFrog Xray, plus software supply-chain controls, multi-stage container builds, artefact repositories and vulnerability remediation.
  • Strong Python and Linux automation skills, with Bash and modern Python packaging tools such as uv, PDM, Poetry or pip, virtual environments, lockfiles and internal Artifactory repositories.
  • Hands-on understanding of the ML lifecycle, including data preparation, training, experiment tracking such as MLflow, packaging, registry, serving, monitoring, drift detection, retraining and rollback.
  • Practical knowledge of LLMOps and AgentOps, including prompt and model versioning, evaluation pipelines, golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, tracing, guardrails, token and context limits, streaming, tool schemas and MCP runtimes.
  • Experience serving deep-learning or LLM workloads at scale; familiarity with vLLM, TGI, Triton, GPUs, CUDA, quantisation and capacity planning is a strong advantage.
  • Familiarity with testing, debugging, and automation frameworks for AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations (e.g., MCP Inspector, Playwright, Scrapy).
  • Solid knowledge of observability and distributed systems, including metrics, logs, traces, alerting, SLOs, performance diagnosis, incident management and post-incident improvement.
  • Strong enterprise networking and security knowledge covering private DNS, proxies, VPC connectivity, firewalls, TLS and corporate CA chains, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, mTLS, IAM, service accounts and least privilege.
  • Experience with data and event platforms such as SQL, Airflow, Spark or Kafka, and with secure integration through API gateways such as Apigee.
  • Understanding of LLM fundamentals, RAG, agentic workflows, prompt injection, excessive agency, tool failure handling, human-in-the-loop controls and separation of development, test and production workloads.
  • Ability to own complex solutions from design through production, explain trade-offs, identify and mitigate risks, establish reusable standards, review engineering work and troubleshoot across application, Kubernetes, network, identity and cloud layers.
  • Clear communication and a collaborative, service-oriented approach; experience in banking, regulated industries, multi-tenant platforms, audit or model-risk environments is an advantage.
  • Cloud, Kubernetes or security certifications such as Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, CKA, AWS or Microsoft Azure certifications are an advantage.

Well-being & Benefits 

Emotionally and mentally balanced: We support you in dealing with life crises, maintaining stability through illness, and maintaining good mental health.  

  • Empowering managers who value your ideas and decisions. Show your positive attitude, determination, and open-mindedness.
  • A professional, passionate, and fun workplace. 
  • A modern office with fun and relaxing areas to boost creativity.  
  • Continuous learning culture with coaching and support from team experts. 
  • A culture where you can openly speak about mental health. 

Physically thriving: We support you in managing your physical health by taking appropriate preventive measures and providing a workplace that helps you thrive. For example, Private healthcare and life insurance with premium benefits for you and discounts for your loved ones, healthier ways of working and check-ups. 

Socially connected: We strongly believe in collaboration, inclusion and feeling connected to open up new perspectives and strengthen our self-confidence and well-being.  

  • 24 days holiday, loyalty days, and bank holidays (including weekdays for weekend bank holidays). 
  • Hybrid working model with 40% remote work. 
  • Options for flexible working hours. 
  • Enjoy retailer discounts, cultural and CSR activities, workshops, and more. 

Financially secure: We support you in meeting personal financial goals during your active career and for the future. 

  • Competitive income, performance-based promotions, and a sense of purpose. 
  • Meal vouchers, bonuses for referrals 

  

Interested in more: discover what our employees value in the Well-being & Benefits hub! 

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.
